title: A domestic ending without identical wishes

captions.physics: Rebuilding domestic schemes after exposed mismatch
captions.energy: Demanding completely matching attitudes to change
captions.emotions: Feeling an outdated form needs releasing

meaning: Your domestic support allows an ending when both can agree for different reasons instead of releasing the unsuitable awaiting identical feeling towards an earlier form.
text: The Tower in the physical position of Muladhara can appear through rebuilding a domestic scheme that failed actual conditions. The Lovers in energy complicate it through demanding identical wishes. Death in emotions feels a need to release the previous form. A necessary transition can receive no action. Both understand mismatch, but one is ready to end while the other still values earlier experience. Different feelings supposedly forbid manageable decisions although shared consent is possible without completely matching every change’s personal meaning.

For example, an old table no longer fits after room conditions change. One wants it removed immediately while the other remembers good evenings despite also seeing inconvenience. **Different feelings towards the previous form do not cancel agreement about the present.** You can recognise experience’s value and choose an available transition. Rebuilding releases a form instead of awaiting an equally easy rejection of a material detail once genuinely supporting shared life.

The difficulty is considering emotional mismatch absent reciprocity and returning to an unworkable method. Distinguishing connection from its former form offers more dependable support: one can continue after the other ends. Support grows through a necessary ending without devaluing history or appointing identical speed of release a compulsory condition for every honest domestic change. Both can preserve respect while moving through the transition differently.
